compiled:
📰 General

MTA Bus Video Reveals Final Moments Before Brooklyn Building Collapse •

New video footage released by the Metropolitan Transportation Authority (MTA) provides a detailed look at the collapse of a building at 1321 Flatbush Avenue in Brooklyn. The video captures a city bus traveling along the street at the time of the incident on November 11th. Investigators are analyzing the footage to understand the precise sequence of events leading up to the building’s sudden failure. The video represents the most comprehensive visual record of the collapse available to date.

🌍 World

Trump’s Continued Warmth for Putin Fuels Concerns About US Foreign Policy •

Former President Donald Trump met with Russian President Vladimir Putin in Moscow, marking the latest in a long-standing relationship characterized by mutual admiration. The meeting, held at Putin’s estate, involved extended conversations focused on Trump’s positive assessment of Putin’s leadership and personal qualities. Analysts suggest this continued engagement reflects a potential strategy to leverage Putin’s influence and potentially undermine Western alliances. The interaction highlights ongoing questions regarding Trump’s approach to US foreign policy and its implications for international relations.

🦅 US

Google’s Gemini Now Controls Your Mac, Automating Tasks Across Apps •

Google announced a new feature for its Gemini AI allowing it to directly control users’ Macs. The AI can now navigate and interact with native Mac applications, such as Safari and Mail. Gemini will perform tasks on behalf of the user, including browsing the internet and managing files. This integration marks a significant step in Gemini’s development, expanding its capabilities beyond simple text-based interactions.

💰 Business

Software Patching Blamed for Wave of Recent Tech Outages Across Industries •

Recent widespread technology outages experienced by various companies are being linked to rushed software patching efforts following the release of Frontier models. Experts believe these hasty updates inadvertently exposed previously unknown zero-day vulnerabilities. The rapid deployment of patches, intended to address security risks, instead triggered instability and disruptions within systems. Investigations are underway to determine the specific vulnerabilities exploited and the extent of the damage caused by this patching strategy.

💻 Technology

Ubisoft Announces Further Layoffs and Launches AI Studio Amid Production Slowdown •

Ubisoft has announced the termination of 166 employees across its Montreal and Quebec studios, coinciding with the upcoming quarterly earnings release. The layoffs are attributed to a lack of significant game releases currently in development. Simultaneously, the company is establishing an internal AI studio, signaling a shift in its development strategy. This restructuring follows previous workforce reductions and reflects a strategic realignment within the company’s operations.

🎭 Entertainment

Playbill Issues Apology Following Controversial “George Floyd the Musical” Casting Call •

Playbill retracted a casting call seeking “comedic singers” for an album for a production titled “George Floyd the Musical,” sparking immediate and widespread criticism. The original listing, published on Wednesday, was deemed deeply offensive and insensitive by theater professionals and the public. The publication issued a formal apology, acknowledging the egregious error and expressing regret for the hurt caused. Playbill stated they were taking steps to ensure similar mistakes do not occur in the future.

🏅 Sports

Troy Aikman Fuels Joe Buck Feud with Critical Comments on ESPN Coverage •

Following ESPN President Jimmy Pitaro’s criticism of media coverage surrounding the Joe Buck and Troy Aikman situation, Aikman offered further commentary. He stated that the media’s focus on the controversy has been “disappointing,” implicitly criticizing the level of attention being given to the situation. Aikman’s remarks suggest a degree of frustration with the ongoing media scrutiny. This adds fuel to the existing tensions between the former broadcast partners.

🔬 Science

Scientists Discover Novel Method to Halt Potential Biological Apocalypse Threat •

Researchers have identified a specific molecular interaction that could prevent a catastrophic “biological apocalypse,” a scenario where DNA replicates incorrectly. The discovery centers on a process where a DNA molecule recognizes its mirrored reflection, triggering a self-correcting mechanism. Scientists believe this feedback loop could be harnessed to combat the uncontrolled replication that drives certain diseases and potentially, a more extreme biological threat. Further research is underway to understand the full implications and potential applications of this groundbreaking finding.

🩺 Health

Daily Diet Soda Consumption Linked to Brain Changes, Gut Issues •

Research suggests that regular consumption of diet soda may negatively impact brain health. Studies indicate aspartame, a common sweetener, can influence neurotransmitters and potentially contribute to mood changes and headaches. Furthermore, daily intake could disrupt the gut-brain connection, potentially affecting hunger signals. The research highlights a possible link between diet soda and alterations in both neurological and digestive function.
